protocol.experiment: Expanded calibration data, fixed feature/model families
protocol.scope: Development comparison on previously inspected datasets; not a new independent test
protocol.baseline: Original 50-label Change and Appearance results remain immutable
protocol.outer_test: Exact original test record IDs, five folds per source
protocol.training: All same-source records excluding held-out record IDs, groups, similarity components and (LeFood) exact raw image hashes across both roles
protocol.inner: Five deterministic group-balanced folds by record count; purge similarity components and raw-image matches from each inner training set; no target values used to build splits
protocol.candidates: Unchanged original 49 candidates; Appearance and Change banks select separately using inner group MAE; no new thresholds or relabeling
protocol.selection_for_demo: Change family only, preserving the product comparison; each fold independently selects its candidate
protocol.promotion: Only source LeFood if all gates pass; retain original model and reference benchmark; fresh independent capture evaluation still needed
protocol.no_changes: No AI labels, mask thresholds, exclusions based on targets, or test-driven parameter search

ACETADA.scope: Conditional development interval for saved outer forecasts; does not include new training runs, label error or institution shift.

LeFood.scope: Conditional development interval for saved outer forecasts; does not include new training runs, label error or institution shift.
